$comment: Generated 2026-10-15. version = newest stable release on or before 2026-10-01 (14-day rule); latest = npm latest on 2026-10-15. sizeGzKB measured with esbuild 0.25 minify + gzip -9, react external, wasm excluded. evidence M = verified this session, V = believed. Notes: knowledge/web/libraries-catalogue.md.
pinRule: exact versions released at least 14 days before install; never ^ in client builds

verdicts.reach: first choice for a named job
verdicts.situational: only when the job needs it
verdicts.reference: study and rebuild in our tokens; do not paste

libraries.name: Base UI
libraries.bestFor: Headless primitives under coss ui and shadcn (default base since 2026-07). Drawer, OTPField, NumberField, Combobox, Toast built in.
libraries.pitfalls: Heavier than Radix per component (measured); render prop not asChild; old package @base-ui-components/react is deprecated.

libraries.name: coss ui
libraries.license: MIT for registry components (apps/ui); AGPL-3.0 for the rest of cosscom/ui incl. the @coss/ui monorepo package
libraries.bestFor: Product apps: the engine's bound component layer (docs/coss-ui.md). 53 primitives + particles + chat UI.
libraries.pitfalls: Install only via the shadcn registry (MIT). Never vendor packages/ui from the GitHub repo (AGPL). Early development; Cal.com look out of the box, re-skin with the bound system tokens.

libraries.name: shadcn/ui
libraries.bestFor: The CLI and registry protocol everything else installs through; blocks, charts (Recharts), AI/chat components; bases: Base UI (default), Radix, React Aria.
libraries.pitfalls: Its default look is the template baseline product-ui-deep.md measures against (30px KPI, 36px rows); never ship unskinned.

libraries.name: Radix UI
libraries.bestFor: Existing Radix codebases (client review-and-fix work). Smallest per-component cost measured.
libraries.pitfalls: Not the engine base: coss ui and shadcn default moved to Base UI. Slower issue throughput reported [V]. Unified package; many rc releases, pin stable.

libraries.name: React Aria Components
libraries.bestFor: The strongest a11y + i18n (date/number/calendar, drag and drop, virtualised collections, tables). Pick when a client app is a11y-audited or date-heavy.
libraries.pitfalls: Different API idiom (render props, data-attributes) from coss; mixing with Base UI in one app doubles primitives.

libraries.name: Ark UI
libraries.bestFor: Zag.js state machines; multi-framework (React/Solid/Vue/Svelte). Chakra v3 and Park UI sit on it.
libraries.pitfalls: No reason to leave Base UI in a React-only engine; Panda CSS ecosystem, not Tailwind-first.

libraries.name: Park UI
libraries.bestFor: Styled Ark UI (Panda or Tailwind). Joined the Chakra org Nov 2025.
libraries.pitfalls: Repo last pushed 2026-04; Panda-centric; generic look.

libraries.name: HeroUI
libraries.bestFor: v3 (2026-03) rewrite on React Aria + Tailwind v4, CSS animations; NextUI successor.
libraries.pitfalls: Strong house look (soft, rounded, consumer) that reads as HeroUI at a glance; package lock-in, not copy-owned. @nextui-org/react is deprecated.

libraries.name: Origin UI
libraries.bestFor: 600+ legacy shadcn-style components (inputs, steppers, timelines, tables) now folded into coss ui particles.
libraries.pitfalls: Legacy Radix-era code kept during the coss transition; prefer the coss particle when one exists.

libraries.name: ReUI
libraries.bestFor: Product-app gaps shadcn/coss lack: Data Grid, Kanban, Filters, File Upload, Sortable, Timeline, Stepper, Gantt; Radix and Base UI flavours.
libraries.pitfalls: KeenThemes admin-template density; re-skin to the bound system (row pitch, radius ladder). Pro tier exists.

libraries.name: AlignUI
libraries.bestFor: The light product-UI grammar the engine already studied (affectui-product-kit.md, benchmarks/alignui-*). Figma synced with React+Tailwind code.
libraries.pitfalls: Paid per developer; pricing pages disagree (Figma ~$119, code ~$299) [V]; do not paste paid source into client repos without a licence.

libraries.name: Untitled UI React
libraries.bestFor: Big, polished, React Aria + Tailwind v4 component set with real dashboards and marketing sections; a good second opinion on states and density.
libraries.pitfalls: Very recognisable Untitled look (purple brand, 8px radius, soft shadows) = template risk; PRO components are licensed separately.

libraries.name: Tailwind Plus + Catalyst
libraries.bestFor: Catalyst's restrained application UI (Headless UI) and the marketing blocks are well proportioned references.
libraries.pitfalls: Tailwind Labs joined Shopify 2026-09-09; new Tailwind Plus sign-ups closed [V]. Headless UI underneath (last release 2026-04). Very recognisable.

libraries.name: Headless UI
libraries.bestFor: Only inside Catalyst code.
libraries.pitfalls: Small component set, slow cadence (2.2.10, 2026-04).

libraries.name: Magic UI
libraries.bestFor: Marquee, number ticker, animated beam, border beam, dot pattern, globe: quick ideas for bento cells.
libraries.pitfalls: The most-seen effects on the web (border beam, shiny button, animated gradient text) = instant template tell. Rebuild with our motion tokens, one at a time.

libraries.name: Aceternity UI
libraries.license: Free components (terms on site) / Pro licence forbids resale and template sale
libraries.bestFor: Mining a concept (e.g. a sticky scroll reveal) only.
libraries.pitfalls: Spotlight, aurora, lamp, background beams, 3D card, meteors = the 2024 AI-landing look the founder rejects; heavy framer-motion per effect; weak reduced-motion handling [V].

libraries.name: Motion Primitives
libraries.bestFor: Restrained Motion-based building blocks: text effect, text morph, animated group, morphing dialog, transition panel, sliding number, in-view, progressive blur.
libraries.pitfalls: Pull single files, then swap transitions for motion-tokens.json values.

libraries.name: Animate UI
libraries.bestFor: Animated versions of primitives (tabs highlight, accordion, popover, switch) and good 'icon animates on hover' sets.
libraries.pitfalls: Commons Clause: fine inside a client product, never redistribute the components (e.g. in a sold kit). Repo last pushed 2025-12.

libraries.name: Cult UI
libraries.bestFor: Dynamic island, expandable cards, texture buttons, family-style transitions; a few genuinely crafted pieces.
libraries.pitfalls: Mixed quality; skeuo 'texture' buttons date fast.

libraries.name: Kokonut UI
libraries.bestFor: AI-chat input and card ideas.
libraries.pitfalls: Gradient-heavy, dribbble-ish defaults; low reuse value for our bar.

libraries.name: Skiper UI
libraries.license: Free + paid ($129 Premium, $549 Exclusive); terms not read
libraries.bestFor: 'Un-common' craft-detail components inspired by Rauno's Devouring Details: image reveal, cursor trail, Vercel-style tooltip, dynamic island.
libraries.pitfalls: Licence terms unread: do not ship paid items in client code until checked.

libraries.name: React Bits
libraries.bestFor: Text animations (split, blur, decrypted), WebGL backgrounds (Silk, Iridescence, Threads, Aurora on OGL). Biggest repo (49k stars).
libraries.pitfalls: Most-copied backgrounds on 2025-26 indie sites (template tell); some pull in OGL or three; Commons Clause on redistribution.

libraries.name: Fancy Components
libraries.bestFor: Typographic and physics play: variable-font hover, text along path, gravity, float, screensaver, letter swap.
libraries.pitfalls: Playful by design; fits brand campaign heroes, rarely product SaaS. Repo last pushed 2026-03.

libraries.name: uiverse
libraries.bestFor: Nothing in our bar.
libraries.pitfalls: Community CSS snippets of very uneven quality; neon/glow buttons; no a11y review; repo stale since 2024.

libraries.name: Motion (motion.dev)
libraries.bestFor: Every React animation: one T timeline, springs, layout/shared layout, AnimatePresence, useScroll, gestures. Kit default.
libraries.pitfalls: Full motion component 41 kB gz measured: use LazyMotion+m (27 kB) on light pages. 14.x is days old; Motion+ ($399 one-time solo) is a private repo, the npm motion-plus package is deprecated.
libraries.note: 14-day rule picks 13.5.0; the kit and every work/* app already run 14.0.0 (2026-10-02, passes the rule on 2026-10-16). Stay on 14.0.0; do not take 14.1-14.3 before 2026-10-23..29.

libraries.name: GSAP
libraries.license: GSAP Standard 'no charge' licence (free incl. commercial; not OSI)
libraries.bestFor: Long scroll-scrubbed pinned storytelling, SVG draw/morph, SplitText (a11y-aware rewrite). All plugins free since the Webflow move.
libraries.pitfalls: Licence forbids use in no-code visual animation builders competing with Webflow; 47 kB gz with ScrollTrigger+SplitText; second animation system next to Motion = two timing languages.

libraries.name: AutoAnimate
libraries.bestFor: Zero-config list add/remove/reorder in product UI (3 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: Fixed easing you cannot tie to motion tokens beyond duration/easing string; no exit choreography.

libraries.name: react-spring
libraries.bestFor: Physics springs; @react-spring/three for R3F.
libraries.pitfalls: Duplicates Motion; smaller ecosystem for UI.

libraries.name: Theatre.js
libraries.bestFor: Keyframed 3D camera choreography with a studio UI (historically).
libraries.pitfalls: Last npm release 2024-05, repo quiet since 2024-08; studio is AGPL.

libraries.name: Lenis
libraries.bestFor: Smooth wheel scrolling for scroll-scrubbed campaign pages synced to GSAP/Motion (lenis/react).
libraries.pitfalls: 0 of 15 measured SaaS benchmark sites use it (Linear, Attio, Stripe, Vercel, Raycast...). Changes native scroll feel; must respect reduced motion; breaks some sticky/anchor behaviour.

libraries.name: React <ViewTransition>
libraries.bestFor: Route and list transitions via the View Transitions API, stable in React 19.3 (2026-09-09). Shared-element morphs between pages without Motion layoutId.
libraries.pitfalls: Only fires for transition updates (startTransition, Suspense reveal, useDeferredValue). The repo kit is on React 19.2.x; needs 19.3. Firefox support of cross-document VT is partial [V].

libraries.name: Paper Shaders
libraries.bestFor: Signature visual fields with zero deps: MeshGradient, GrainGradient, Dithering, Halftone, PaperTexture, LiquidMetal, GodRays, Warp, Waves. Quorum's accepted stage uses GrainGradient.
libraries.pitfalls: 0.0.x: props can break between releases, pin exact. Some shaders embed a noise texture (GrainGradient+Dithering 30 kB gz vs MeshGradient 8 kB). Pause offscreen; one looping shader per fold.

libraries.name: Unicorn Studio
libraries.license: Wrapper MIT (community, not official); scenes need Legend plan ($168/yr) for commercial use and no watermark [V]
libraries.bestFor: Designer-authored WebGL scenes (layers, effects, mouse interaction) when a Paper shader is not enough.
libraries.pitfalls: 226 kB gz measured; scene JSON from Unicorn's CDN; free plan is non-commercial with branding; community wrapper (1 maintainer).

libraries.name: Spline
libraries.license: No licence field on npm (proprietary runtime)
libraries.bestFor: Quick interactive 3D objects for prototypes.
libraries.pitfalls: 1,063 kB gz measured for react-spline + runtime, before the scene file. Kills LCP/INP on mobile; looks 'Spline' (soft clay 3D). If needed, render to video/PNG sequence instead.

libraries.name: Rive
libraries.bestFor: State-machine illustrations and interactive icons/onboarding that respond to hover/input (art-direction M35).
libraries.pitfalls: 67 kB gz JS + ~800 kB gz wasm measured; lazy-load and start on IntersectionObserver; needs a Rive artist.

libraries.name: dotLottie
libraries.bestFor: Designer After Effects animations (.lottie, themable) for small icon/illustration loops.
libraries.pitfalls: 14 kB gz JS + ~485 kB gz wasm measured. Lottie loops read 2019-SaaS; never in the hero.

libraries.name: lottie-web
libraries.bestFor: Legacy JSON Lottie.
libraries.pitfalls: 77 kB gz, no release since 2025-05; use dotLottie or a CSS/Motion rebuild.

libraries.name: three.js
libraries.bestFor: Real 3D (product objects, globes with lighting, particles at scale).
libraries.pitfalls: 186 kB gz measured for a namespace import; needs a 3D-capable designer to look premium; mobile GPU budget.

libraries.name: React Three Fiber + drei
libraries.bestFor: three.js in React with drei helpers (Environment, MeshTransmissionMaterial, Float, Text) and @react-three/postprocessing.
libraries.pitfalls: 244 kB gz measured with a minimal Canvas; lazy-mount below the fold or behind a poster frame.

libraries.name: OGL
libraries.bestFor: Hand-written full-screen fragment shaders (custom dither, fluid, field) at 13 kB gz when Paper has no match.
libraries.pitfalls: Raw WebGL ergonomics; last release 2025-01; you own resize, DPR cap, visibility pause and reduced-motion still frame.

libraries.name: cobe
libraries.bestFor: The 6 kB dotted WebGL globe (Vercel/Stripe-style).
libraries.pitfalls: Instantly recognised; only when geography is the claim. The kit already has d3-geo for drawn maps.

libraries.name: ShaderGradient
libraries.license: MIT on npm (repo no licence file)
libraries.bestFor: Animated 3D gradient blobs.
libraries.pitfalls: Pulls three + R3F; the 'colour blob behind type' look the dark-mode rules forbid; last npm release 2025-12.

libraries.name: Vanta.js
libraries.bestFor: Nothing.
libraries.pitfalls: Last release 2022-09; three r1xx-era effects (birds, net, waves) read dated and generic.

libraries.name: Hand-built SVG (+ d3-shape/d3-scale)
libraries.bestFor: Hero and bento product mockups: 14-bar sparklines, step charts with gradient strokes, segment meters, distribution bars sized to the type (Kargul pattern).
libraries.pitfalls: You own axes, tooltips and a11y (role=img + aria-label with the numbers).

libraries.name: visx
libraries.bestFor: Low-level React SVG primitives when a mockup needs real axes, brushes, gradients or annotations at Attio/Kargul fidelity (20 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: Not a chart library: you compose everything; v4.0.0 (2026-06).

libraries.name: Recharts
libraries.bestFor: Real product-app charts via shadcn/coss chart wrappers: tooltips, legends, responsive, quick.
libraries.pitfalls: 106 kB gz measured; default ticks/grid/tooltip look generic: restyle axis type to 11-12px tabular, kill vertical grid, custom tooltip.

libraries.name: Tremor
libraries.bestFor: Copy-paste Recharts dashboard components and 300+ free blocks (Vercel-owned since 2025-01).
libraries.pitfalls: npm package frozen at 3.18.7 (2025-01); the copy-paste site is the live product; recognisable Tremor dashboard look.

libraries.name: Nivo
libraries.bestFor: Exotic chart types (sankey, chord, calendar heatmap) in internal tools.
libraries.pitfalls: 94 kB gz for one line chart; last release 2025-05; distinctive Nivo defaults.

libraries.name: ECharts
libraries.bestFor: Heavy analytics apps (100k points, maps, candlesticks) where completeness beats weight.
libraries.pitfalls: 171 kB gz tree-shaken, 375 kB full; canvas by default (use SVGRenderer for crispness); echarts-for-react dist-tag latest 3.0.6 lags published 3.2.7.

libraries.name: uPlot
libraries.bestFor: Fast canvas time series (monitoring, logs, 1M points) at 23 kB gz.
libraries.pitfalls: Canvas, imperative API, minimal styling; last release 2025-03.

libraries.name: Chart.js
libraries.bestFor: Non-React or quick internal charts.
libraries.pitfalls: 69 kB gz (auto); canvas text never matches the page type; generic look.

libraries.name: NumberFlow
libraries.bestFor: Animated KPI/price/counter digits with correct Intl formatting (6 kB gz). The 'live counter beats static claim' bento move.
libraries.pitfalls: Set tabular-nums font features; respects reduced motion; do not animate every number on the page.

libraries.name: Sonner
libraries.bestFor: Toasts in non-coss React apps (9 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: In coss/Base UI apps use toastManager.add() (Base UI Toast) instead; never both.

libraries.name: Vaul
libraries.bestFor: Was the mobile drawer.
libraries.pitfalls: README: 'This repo is unmaintained' (last release 2024-12). Use Base UI Drawer (stable since 1.3) / coss drawer.

libraries.name: cmdk
libraries.bestFor: Command palette in Radix-based apps; fuzzy filtering.
libraries.pitfalls: Last release 2025-03; in coss apps use the coss command component (Base UI Autocomplete/Combobox).

libraries.name: input-otp
libraries.bestFor: OTP field in non-Base UI apps (4 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: Base UI OTPField is stable since 1.6; coss ships otp-field.

libraries.name: react-resizable-panels
libraries.bestFor: Split panes in product apps (sidebar/inspector/editor), persisted layouts.
libraries.pitfalls: v4 renamed exports (Group, Panel, Separator); shadcn resizable wrapper may lag.

libraries.name: Embla Carousel
libraries.bestFor: Any carousel (testimonials, template galleries) with real drag physics (8 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: Bring your own controls and a11y labels; avoid auto-play.

libraries.name: TanStack Table
libraries.bestFor: Headless data tables: sort, filter, select, pin, group.
libraries.pitfalls: v9 changed the API (useTable replaces useReactTable; measured exports); most shadcn data-table examples are v8. Pin 8.x if copying old examples.

libraries.name: TanStack Virtual
libraries.bestFor: Virtualised long lists/tables (8 kB gz).
libraries.pitfalls: Needs fixed or measured row heights; keep row pitch tokens.

libraries.name: React DayPicker
libraries.bestFor: Calendars/date ranges; under shadcn and coss calendar.
libraries.pitfalls: v10 (2026-09) peers date-fns 4 + @date-fns/tz; check wrapper compatibility before bumping.

libraries.name: date-fns
libraries.bestFor: Realistic relative dates in sample data and product UI (tree-shakes to ~6 kB).
libraries.pitfalls: Use Intl for formatting where possible; date-fns 4 is ESM-first.

libraries.name: Lucide
libraries.bestFor: Default product icon set (coss/shadcn default); 2px stroke, 24 grid; set strokeWidth 1.5 at 16px.
libraries.pitfalls: The most common set = default look; ships a release almost daily (pin). Pair with absoluteStrokeWidth for small sizes.

libraries.name: Phosphor
libraries.bestFor: Six weights incl. duotone/fill: the quickest way to a non-Lucide voice; already in the kit.
libraries.pitfalls: Last release 2025-05; import from /dist/ssr in RSC; Icon-suffixed names.

libraries.name: Tabler Icons
libraries.bestFor: Breadth (6k+) for dense admin UI and rare glyphs.
libraries.pitfalls: Uneven drawing quality across the huge set; 2px stroke default.

libraries.name: Hugeicons
libraries.bestFor: Free 'stroke rounded' 6k set; Pro has 10 styles. A softer alternative to Lucide.
libraries.pitfalls: Two packages (@hugeicons/react + @hugeicons/core-free-icons, 78 MB unpacked); the old hugeicons/react repo is archived.

libraries.name: Remix Icon
libraries.license: Remix Icon License 1.0 (free commercial use; no standalone icon-pack sale or competing icon library)
libraries.bestFor: Line + fill pairs for active/inactive nav states; neutral geometric voice; already in the kit.
libraries.pitfalls: Licence changed from Apache-2.0 to a custom licence in 2026-01; fine for client sites, not for building an icon product.

libraries.name: Heroicons
libraries.bestFor: Tailwind Plus code.
libraries.pitfalls: Small set (~300), last release 2024-11, strongly Tailwind-UI flavoured.

libraries.name: Central Icons
libraries.bestFor: The premium set used by top product designers: every package is one shape/radius/stroke combination, so icon corners can match the radius ladder.
libraries.pitfalls: Paid; needs a licence key at install (env var); one npm package per style; 52 MB unpacked.
libraries.install: CENTRAL_LICENSE_KEY=... npm i @central-icons-react/round-outlined-radius-2-stroke-1.5@1.2.1 [V on key var name]

libraries.name: Untitled UI Icons
libraries.bestFor: 1,100+ clean 1.5px-stroke icons that match Untitled UI layouts.
libraries.pitfalls: 0.0.x versioning; pairs best with the Untitled look (template risk).

libraries.name: Simple Icons
libraries.bestFor: Integration logos inside product mockups (Slack, GitHub, Stripe tiles).
libraries.pitfalls: Never as 'customer logos' (invented proof). Trademark guidelines per brand.

libraries.name: Inter (variable)
libraries.bestFor: Product UI text with opsz axis, tabular nums, cv11/ss01.
libraries.pitfalls: Default = template risk for display; use Inter Tight or a voice from type-voices.md for h1.

libraries.name: Inter Tight
libraries.bestFor: Display headlines in the Inter family (Quorum accepted).
libraries.pitfalls: Never for body text.

libraries.name: Geist + Geist Mono
libraries.bestFor: Kit default sans + mono; Geist Pixel exists for one-off display accents.
libraries.pitfalls: Vercel association; vary per the variety picker.

libraries.name: Instrument Serif
libraries.bestFor: One italic serif word in a grotesk headline (light-hero-grammars.md).
libraries.pitfalls: Static (no variable package): only 400 regular + italic; overused as 'the serif word'.

libraries.name: Newsreader
libraries.bestFor: Editorial serif with opsz for long-form or docs-voiced brands.
libraries.pitfalls: 1.25 MB package (load the latin subset only).

libraries.name: Fraunces
libraries.bestFor: Warm 'soft' serif with WONK/SOFT axes for consumer or food/craft brands.
libraries.pitfalls: Strong personality; wrong for B2B infra.

libraries.name: JetBrains Mono
libraries.bestFor: Code blocks and dev-tool voice.
libraries.pitfalls: Wide; use Geist Mono for small UI labels.

libraries.name: Switzer / Satoshi / General Sans (Fontshare)
libraries.bestFor: Distinctive neutral grotesks without OFL ubiquity.
libraries.pitfalls: Not on npm/Fontsource. FFL 2.0 (read in the download): self-hosting on your own site is allowed, but no subsetting/format conversion, no handing files to agencies/contractors (the client must download its own copy), no serving to third-party users in a SaaS/template editor.
